key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:099E
name: read_confirmation_response
description: Returns a stored yes or no decision from a state flag when one is already set. Otherwise it reads response characters until an affirmative or negative letter arrives, mapping the letters A, N, Q, S, Y and their lowercase forms to a result of 1, 0 or -1.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1140
name: test_whitespace_character
description: Returns 1 when the character in the data register is a space, tab, line feed or carriage return, and 0 for any other character.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:11E4
name: parse_lha_command_line
description: Splits the command-line argument string into words and quoted strings, recognises option switches and at-sign include files, and reads the LHAOPTS environment variable when it is set. It reports illegal commands and unterminated quotes with the matching messages.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:16EC
name: parse_decimal_digit
description: Returns the value of a decimal digit character and advances the caller's string position by one. It returns 1 without advancing when the character is not a digit.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:18B0
name: parse_lha_option_letter
description: Dispatches on one option letter, storing values such as the multivolume size and task priority and parsing their numeric arguments. Invalid options, invalid extended options, bad multivolume sizes and invalid task priorities print their matching warning text.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1B88
name: normalize_option_defaults
description: Fills in unset option values from the command letter and whether standard input is interactive. It clamps the header level to the 0 to 2 range, warning and using 0 when the value is out of range.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1CC0
name: forward_to_handler
description: Trampoline that calls another routine through the library jump table and returns, with no other work of its own.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1CC8
name: release_open_resources
description: Walks three tables of open entries. Entries flagged for deletion have their named file removed while the current directory is saved and restored; the other entries are closed, unlocked or have their memory blocks freed through the library jump table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1F08
name: open_file_into_slot
description: Searches a table of ten slots for an empty entry, opens a file through the library jump table and stores the returned handle in that slot. It returns zero when the table is full.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1F4E
name: close_and_clear_slot
description: Finds the table slot holding the value passed in the data register, closes that handle through the library jump table and clears the slot.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1F8E
name: lock_file_into_slot
description: Finds a free entry in a 64-slot table, obtains a lock on a file through the library jump table and stores it there. It returns zero when no slot is free.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1FD4
name: store_value_in_free_slot
description: Puts the value passed in the data register into the first empty entry of a 64-slot table. It does nothing when the table is full.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1FE2
name: store_at_list_length_index
description: Counts how many leading nonzero entries the pointed-to list holds, up to 64, and writes the register value into the table slot at that index when it is in range.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1FFA
name: store_value_at_table_index
description: Writes the value held in one data register into the 64-slot table at the index held in another data register, with no bounds check.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:200E
name: unlock_and_clear_slot
description: Finds the 64-slot table entry matching the value in the data register, clears it, releases that lock through the library jump table and then runs a cleanup routine.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2052
name: copy_stored_name_to_buffer
description: Copies the zero-terminated name held in a state field into a local 256-byte buffer, then passes it on to two follow-up routines. The reference text LhATmp suggests a temporary file name.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:228A
name: allocate_file_entry
description: Finds a free slot in a ten-entry table, allocates a new entry record and fills its fields from the mode letter, covering write, multivolume and temporary variants. It returns the record, or zero when no slot or allocation is available.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:22A0
name: allocate_file_entry_indexed
description: Works like the file entry allocator but takes its free slot from a counter held in the caller's frame, then writes the new record into that slot.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:22CC
name: build_file_entry_record
description: Allocates and initialises an entry record from the mode letter and the caller's counter, then stores it in the ten-slot table. The caller is expected to have chosen the slot already.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:22DE
name: finish_file_entry_setup
description: Completes an entry record that is already allocated: sets its flags and fields from the mode letter, runs the writable-file helper where needed and stores the record in the ten-slot table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2308
name: set_entry_fields_for_mode
description: Clears the record's first field and sets its counters and flags from the mode letter, running the lock step for write-capable modes. It then stores the record in the ten-slot table at the index taken from the caller's frame.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2354
name: apply_entry_mode_flags
description: Checks a status result and the mode letter, setting the record's flags for the chosen mode, then records the entry in the ten-slot table. It returns early when the status is zero in write mode.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2370
name: examine_and_set_entry_mode
description: Applies mode letter flags to an entry record after an optional release step, reads file information for the record through the library examine call, and stores the record in the ten-slot table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23A0
name: set_mode_flags_and_store
description: Applies the mode letter flags to an entry record, fills its name and memory fields through helper routines, and stores the record in the ten-slot table at the index from the caller's frame.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23D4
name: fill_entry_fields_and_store
description: Fills the entry record's buffer fields from helper calls, clears its counters and stores the record in the ten-slot table. It exits early when a helper reports failure.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23D8
name: fill_entry_name_and_store
description: Fills the entry record's name and counter fields from helper calls and stores the record in the ten-slot table. It exits early when a helper reports failure.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23DC
name: mark_entry_temporary_and_store
description: Sets a group of flag bits in the entry record, fills its name and counter fields from helper calls and stores the record in the ten-slot table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23E6
name: mark_entry_extended_and_store
description: Sets a second group of flag bits in the entry record, fills its name and counter fields from helper calls and stores the record in the ten-slot table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23F0
name: mark_entry_flag_and_store
description: Sets the high flag bit in the entry record, fills its name and counter fields from helper calls and stores the record in the ten-slot table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:23FA
name: mark_entry_flag_and_fill
description: Sets the high flag bit in the entry record, fills its name and counter fields through helper calls with a retry, and stores the record in the ten-slot table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2424
name: fill_entry_size_fields
description: Clears a counter field and fills the entry's size and offset fields through helper calls. It exits early when a helper reports failure.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:243E
name: retry_entry_name_fill
description: Obtains a value from a helper and retries once with a second call when the first returns zero. It then fills the entry's counter fields and stores the record in the ten-slot table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2482
name: reset_entry_read_position
description: Clears the entry's first field, fills its counter field from a helper that uses the library seek call, and stores the record in the ten-slot table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:24E6
name: release_entry_record
description: Releases one entry record: removes its file when it was flagged for deletion, frees its name and buffer fields through helpers, and clears its slot in the ten-slot table. Null records are ignored.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2564
name: seek_within_entry_segments
description: Searches a table of up to 128 segment ranges for the one containing the requested offset, seeks to the matching position through the library jump table and returns the result, or -1 when the seek fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:261C
name: open_next_volume_file
description: Builds the name of the next archive volume from the base name and a two-digit volume number, then opens it. When the file cannot be opened it reports a wrong volume error and repeats the prompt until the file opens or the user quits.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2736
name: refill_read_buffer
description: Allocates the read buffer on first use and refills it through the library read call when the current position runs past the buffered range. It returns the number of bytes now available, or -1 on failure.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2764
name: refill_buffered_read_block
description: Refills the buffer through the library read call when the buffered range is used up, allocating a new block when none is held. It returns the available byte count, or -1 when the read fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2790
name: read_block_with_error_code
description: Allocates a buffer block when none is held, refills the read buffer through the library read call and returns the number of bytes available. On failure it stores the library error code in the state block and returns -1.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:27C2
name: update_position_after_read
description: After a successful read step, moves the buffered position counters forward and stores the new position returned by the library call. When the read fails, it stores the library error code and returns -1.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:27E4
name: read_into_buffer_block
description: Moves the buffered position counters forward, reads the next block through the library read call and returns the result it stored in the entry record.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2814
name: flush_entry_output_buffer
description: Writes pending output for an entry record in write mode when it holds unsaved data, using the library write call. It records a library error code when the write fails and returns zero when nothing needs writing.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:28FC
name: seek_entry_position
description: Repositions an entry record for an absolute or relative seek, returning -1 for an invalid mode or a failed helper. Otherwise it updates the buffered position fields.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2912
name: reposition_entry_offset
description: Repositions an entry record to the given offset through a helper, updating its buffered position fields. It returns the previous position, or -1 when the helper fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2928
name: set_entry_offset_fields
description: Updates an entry record's buffered offset fields to the given position, calling a helper to refill the block when the position falls outside the current range.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:292C
name: set_entry_offset_relative
description: Adds a relative displacement to the entry's current position and updates its buffered offset fields. A helper refills the block when the new position falls outside the current range.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2932
name: stub_return_failure
description: Routine that only returns the value minus one, signalling failure to its caller, with no other work.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2936
name: set_entry_offset_from_register
description: Updates an entry record's buffered offset fields to the position held in a data register, calling a helper to refill the block when that position is outside the current range.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2954
name: reset_entry_buffer_window
description: Marks the entry's buffer window as invalid, sets its start offset to the value passed in and clears the buffered count, then calls a helper.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2966
name: set_entry_buffer_count
description: Stores the difference between the passed value and the entry's start offset as its buffered count, then calls a helper.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:29E0
name: copy_from_entry_buffer
description: Copies the requested number of bytes from the entry's buffer block through a copy helper, refilling the block when it runs out. It returns the number of bytes copied, or -1 when a refill fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A00
name: copy_entry_bytes_with_counter
description: Copies bytes out of the entry's buffer block like the buffered copy routine, adding to the caller's running total as it goes. It returns the total, or -1 when a refill fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A14
name: copy_entry_bytes_until_end
description: Repeatedly copies from the entry's buffer block until the requested count is satisfied or the end of the entry is reached, refilling as needed. It returns the total number of bytes handled.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A22
name: copy_entry_bytes_checked
description: Copies from the entry's buffer block in steps, returning the bytes handled so far and marking the block as finished when the end of the entry is reached. It returns -1 when a refill fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A30
name: copy_entry_bytes_memory
description: Copies bytes from the entry buffer into the target with the library memory copy call, refilling when the block is exhausted, and marks the entry as finished at the end. It returns the total number of bytes copied.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A6E
name: copy_entry_bytes_block_refill
description: Copies the entry's buffered bytes with the library memory copy call, refilling from the source as each block runs out. It returns the byte count, or -1 when a refill fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2A9C
name: copy_entry_bytes_marking_status
description: Sets status bits on the entry record, then copies the requested bytes out of the buffer block, refilling as needed. It updates the stored high-water mark and returns the number of bytes copied.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2ABC
name: copy_entry_bytes_with_status
description: Sets the status flag on the entry record, then copies bytes from the buffer block in steps, refilling as needed and advancing the high-water mark. It returns the number of bytes copied, or -1 when a refill fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2AC6
name: copy_entry_bytes_stepwise
description: Copies bytes from the entry buffer block in steps, refilling when needed and recording the buffered high-water mark. It returns the running byte total.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2AD6
name: copy_entry_bytes_mark_flag
description: Copies from the entry buffer block with the library memory copy call in steps, refilling between steps and setting the buffered flag. It returns the total number of bytes copied.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2B20
name: copy_entry_bytes_tail_loop
description: Finishes a copy from the entry's buffer block through the library memory copy call, setting the buffered flag and advancing the high-water mark. It returns the running byte total, or -1 when a refill fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2FCE
name: write_byte_to_entry_buffer
description: Appends one byte to the entry's output buffer, allocating the buffer on first use, advancing the write position and high-water mark, and flushing when the buffer is full. It returns -1 when the entry is in an error state.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2FF0
name: append_byte_to_output_buffer
description: Appends the byte in the data register to the entry's output buffer, advancing the write position and high-water mark, and flushes when the buffer is full. It returns -1 when the entry is in an error state.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:2FFC
name: store_byte_flush_when_full
description: Stores the byte in the data register at the write position of the entry buffer, updates the high-water mark and flushes the buffer when it is full.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3032
name: stub_return_zero
description: Routine that returns zero immediately, with no other work.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:303A
name: read_byte_from_entry_buffer
description: Reads the next byte from the entry's buffer after a refill check. It marks the entry as finished and returns -1 when no byte is available.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3052
name: read_buffered_byte
description: Returns the byte at the current read position of the entry's buffer and advances that position, with no refill check.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:30B4
name: check_break_signal_once
description: Polls the task signal mask through the library call and, when the break bit is set, runs two helpers and sets a state flag so that the handling happens only once.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:30BA
name: read_char_checking_break
description: Reads one character through two library helpers and, when it equals the break character code, runs the break signal check before returning it.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:30C0
name: forward_to_helper
description: Trampoline that calls another routine and returns, with no other work of its own.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F64
name: append_path_component
description: Appends a second string to the first as a path part, inserting a slash between them unless the first ends in a colon or slash. When the first string is empty it copies the second string into it.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F6A
name: unlink_list_node
description: Removes a node from a doubly linked list by joining its neighbours, using the node's back and forward links.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F70
name: scan_back_for_separator
description: Scans backward through a path string looking for a directory separator, stopping at the start of the string or at a volume colon. It returns without a result value.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F7C
name: duplicate_string_copy
description: Measures a zero-terminated string, allocates memory for a copy through a helper, copies the string into it and returns the new buffer, or zero when the allocation fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F82
name: allocate_memory_retrying
description: Requests a memory block through a helper and, when the request fails, checks the break flag and waits for the user's response. It quits on a Q or q response and otherwise retries, returning the block's payload address on success.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F88
name: allocate_memory_retrying
description: Requests a memory block through a helper and, when the request fails, checks the break flag and waits for the user's response. It quits on a Q or q response and otherwise retries, returning the block's payload address on success.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F8E
name: init_empty_list_head
description: Points both link fields of the node at itself, creating an empty circular list head.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3F9A
name: insert_list_node_before
description: Inserts a node into a doubly linked list immediately before the given node, relinking the neighbouring pointers on both sides.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3FA0
name: dispatch_by_state_flag
description: Calls one of two helpers depending on whether a state field is set, one of them through a different jump table offset.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3FA6
name: emit_local_buffer_string
description: When a state field is clear, calls a helper, measures a local 1024-byte text buffer up to its terminator, passes it through a library call and finishes with a cleanup helper.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3FAC
name: call_helper_then_library
description: Calls one helper and then a library routine through the jump table, returning nothing.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3FB4
name: read_chunk_with_retry_limit
description: Works out how many bytes remain in a window, caps that at a block size and reads the chunk through a helper. It advances the position, marks the buffer end with a zero byte when the window is full, and gives up with an error after six empty attempts.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:3FEA
name: read_chunk_into_window
description: Reads a chunk of the requested size through a helper, advances the position and marks the buffer end with a zero byte when the window is full. It returns the chunk size, or -1 on a short read.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:4010
name: advance_window_position
description: Advances the window position by the given count, marking the buffer end with a zero byte when the window is full. It returns the stored chunk length.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:4034
name: close_window_handle
description: Closes the window's handle: when its mode field is minus one it runs a helper, otherwise it calls the library function on the open handle. A failed library call records a library error code and returns -1; otherwise the stored value is returned.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:4056
name: flush_window_output
description: Flushes the window's buffered output through the library write call when it has pending data, recording the library error code and returning -1 on failure. Otherwise it returns the stored value.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:4084
name: return_window_field
description: Returns the window field at a fixed offset with no other work.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:408E
name: return_helper_unless_stopped
description: Returns zero when an error or stop state flag is set; otherwise it returns the result of a helper call.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:40A2
name: forward_to_default_helper
description: Trampoline that calls another routine and returns, with no other work of its own.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:40BE
name: finish_window_handle
description: Finishes a window handle: when its mode field is minus one it runs a helper, otherwise, if a pending flag is set, it calls the library routine and records the library error code, returning -1 on failure. It returns the stored field value otherwise.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:40E0
name: flush_window_output_checked
description: Writes out a pending window buffer through the library write call when the pending flag is set, storing the library error code and returning -1 on failure. Otherwise it returns the stored field.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:410E
name: return_window_result
description: Returns the stored result field of the window with no other work.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:4118
name: store_result_with_status
description: Calls two helpers, stores the second result as a 16-bit value in the state block, and returns the first result with a minus one mapped to zero.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:43C4
name: decompress_lzss_stream
description: Decodes an LZSS compressed stream: it fills a 4096-byte ring buffer with spaces, then reads flag bits and copies either literal bytes or back-references from the ring buffer to the output until the input runs out.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:469C
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The bytes here do not decode to a valid instruction, so there is no real routine to describe. It is a single undecodable entry.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:46F2
name: report_stored_message
description: Reads a value through a helper, then calls a formatting routine with a message containing the word Stored and the stored state values, followed by an optional helper when a flag is set.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:4742
name: emit_mode_dependent_value
description: Dispatches on a mode value in the state block: mode one emits the next byte of a four-entry rotating buffer, mode two emits 100 or a supplied value, mode three emits a bounded value through helpers, and other modes call a fallback helper. The routine returns zero.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:4762
name: emit_mode_value_register
description: Performs the same mode-driven value emission as the frame-based emitter, but takes its argument from a data register. It returns zero.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:4782
name: emit_rotating_buffer_byte
description: Advances a two-bit index into a four-entry state buffer, emits the byte found there through a helper and returns zero.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:47AC
name: emit_default_or_computed_value
description: Emits a value through a helper: the fixed default of 100 when the data register is zero, otherwise a value computed by two helpers. It returns zero.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:47C0
name: emit_constant_hundred
description: Passes the constant 100 to a helper and returns zero.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:47D0
name: update_stored_maximum
description: Works out a limit of 19, or one less than a helper's value when the data register is nonzero, and when the stored 16-bit value is below that limit it calls two helpers and stores the new limit. It returns zero.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:47E8
name: print_separator_line
description: When the stored counter is below 19, prints a row of underscore characters through the library output and write calls and sets the counter to 19. It returns zero.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:55CC
name: set_status_two_and_report
description: Obtains a value from a helper, sets a state field to 2, passes four state fields to a helper and then runs four further helpers.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:5A76
name: record_archive_name_fields
description: Copies two leading bytes into state fields, sets a flag mask on an entry in a table and passes the remaining text on to a helper that prints an archive heading.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:5A9E
name: resolve_work_directory
description: Resolves the work directory when none is recorded yet: it looks up the current task through the library call, reports a mismatch error when the lookup result does not match the expected value, and stores the resulting directory name. Otherwise it runs a check and cleanup helper.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:5B4E
name: dispatch_archive_command
description: Main command dispatcher that reports the outcome of an archive operation with one of the success, partial success or failure messages, and rejects unknown command letters with an unimplemented-command message. The decompiler timed out, so the detailed control flow is not verified.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:63C2
name: write_output_if_enabled
description: Calls two helpers, then sends a message through the library output and write calls only when two state fields are both clear.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:7BEC
name: replace_path_extension
description: Scans backward from the end of the path for a dot that comes after the last directory separator. When it finds one it overwrites the extension with the new text, otherwise it appends the new text to the end of the path.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:7C40
name: format_nibble_digits
description: Converts a value into text by repeatedly taking its top four bits and looking each up in a digit table, shifting left until no significant digits remain, then writes a zero terminator.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:7C72
name: parse_signed_decimal
description: Parses an optional leading minus sign and a run of decimal digits into a signed integer, stopping at the first non-digit character.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:7CAE
name: copy_bounded_string
description: Copies characters from the source string to the destination, stopping after the terminating zero or when the count runs out. It does nothing when the destination is null.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:7CB4
name: copy_string_with_limit
description: Copies the source string to the destination, returning as soon as the terminating zero is copied or the count runs out.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:7E10
name: lowercase_or_map_string
description: Rewrites a zero-terminated string in place. When a mode flag is set each byte is replaced through a translation table; otherwise upper-case ASCII letters are converted to lower case.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:7F74
name: match_wildcard_pattern
description: Compares a pattern string with a name, treating a question mark as a single-character wildcard and an asterisk as a run of any characters. It returns zero on a match and one on a mismatch, calling a helper for asterisk runs.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:7F8C
name: match_pattern_character
description: Compares one pattern character with one name character, advancing through the pattern and the name. It returns 0 when they match and 1 when they do not.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:7FB6
name: scan_name_for_character
description: Scans backward through the name for a given character, calling a helper on each step. It returns once the character is found, and a result of one when the start of the name is reached first.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:7FC6
name: stub_return_one
description: Routine that returns one, with no other work.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:8E96
name: forward_to_utility_helper
description: Trampoline that calls another routine and returns, with no other work of its own.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:8EA4
name: count_down_delay
description: Busy-wait loop that counts a 16-bit value down from the value passed in the data register, then returns.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:9F96
name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use; it performs no work.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:9FA0
name: stub_return_constant_one
description: Routine that only returns one, with no other work.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:AF84
name: build_path_entry_node_checked
description: Builds a list node for the base name of a path, linking it into a list and filling its fields from library lookups. It returns the node value, or zero when the initial check or the setup fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:AFA6
name: build_path_entry_node
description: Builds a list node for the base name of a path, copying the name after the last separator, linking the node and filling its size and location fields from library lookups. It returns zero when the setup fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:AFBA
name: build_parent_directory_node
description: Locks the parent directory through the library call and builds a list node for the base name of the path, linking it and filling its fields. It returns zero when the setup fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:AFE2
name: build_entry_node_value
description: Builds a list node for the base name of the path, links it, fills its size and location fields from library lookups and returns the node's stored field value.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:AFF4
name: exchange_port_message_for_name
description: Finds the base name of the path, builds a list node for it, then exchanges a message with another task through the library port calls, waiting for the reply before returning the stored field.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B0FC
name: lock_file_into_slot
description: Finds a free entry in a 64-slot table, obtains a lock on a file through the library jump table and stores it there. It returns zero when no slot is free.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B102
name: unlock_and_clear_slot
description: Finds the 64-slot table entry matching the value in the data register, clears it, releases that lock through the library jump table and then runs a cleanup routine.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B108
name: store_value_in_free_slot
description: Puts the value passed in the data register into the first empty entry of a 64-slot table. It does nothing when the table is full.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B110
name: format_text_via_library
description: Calls a library routine that formats text through the jump table, and returns zero.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B134
name: forward_to_handler
description: Trampoline that calls another routine and returns, with no other work of its own.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B1AE
name: free_all_list_nodes
description: Walks a circular list headed in the state block and releases each node's memory through the library free call.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B1E4
name: allocate_memory_retrying
description: Requests a memory block through a helper and, when the request fails, checks the break flag and waits for the user's response. It quits on a Q or q response and otherwise retries, returning the block's payload address on success.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B258
name: allocate_memory_retrying
description: Requests a memory block through the library allocation call and, when it fails, waits for the user's response with a retry or quit prompt. It quits on a Q or q response and otherwise retries, returning the block on success.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B2D0
name: free_memory_block
description: Releases a memory block through the library free call, after a preparatory helper that works out the block size.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B300
name: duplicate_string_copy
description: Measures a zero-terminated string, allocates memory for a copy through a helper, copies the string into it and returns the new buffer, or zero when the allocation fails.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B330
name: unlink_list_node
description: Removes a node from a doubly linked list by joining its neighbours, using the node's back and forward links.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B33E
name: insert_list_node_before
description: Inserts a node into a doubly linked list immediately before the given node, relinking the neighbouring pointers on both sides.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B356
name: insert_list_node_before
description: Inserts a node into a doubly linked list immediately before the given node, relinking the neighbouring pointers on both sides.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B36C
name: insert_list_node_after
description: Inserts a node into a doubly linked list immediately after the given node, relinking the neighbouring pointers on both sides.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B380
name: init_empty_list_head
description: Points both link fields of the node at itself, creating an empty circular list head.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B388
name: forward_to_handler
description: Trampoline that calls another routine and returns, with no other work of its own.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B43A
name: send_port_message_and_wait
description: Builds a message node for the given value, sends it to another task through the library port calls, waits for the reply and returns the stored reply field.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B4C0
name: scale_operands_for_quotient
description: Halves two operands repeatedly until their difference fits a fixed range, then calls two helpers to produce a result. It returns zero when the reduced first operand is zero.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B4CA
name: scale_operands_register_pair
description: Performs the same operand reduction on the data registers directly. It returns zero when the reduced value is zero, and otherwise the result of two helper calls.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B4F4
name: stub_return_zero
description: Routine that returns zero immediately, with no other work.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B4FC
name: check_break_signal_once
description: Polls the task signal mask through the library call and, when the break bit is set, runs two helpers and sets a state flag so that the handling happens only once.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B540
name: write_string_to_output
description: When a state flag is clear, sends a zero-terminated string through the library output and write calls. Otherwise it only measures the string before calling a helper, and then calls a further helper.

name: write_local_buffer_when_idle
description: When a state field is clear, writes a local 1024-byte text buffer through the library output and write calls, bracketed by two helpers. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: expand_bit_register_to_characters
description: Performs the same eight-bit to character expansion as the byte expander, reading its bit mask from a data register and its characters from the state table.

name: expand_bit_runs_to_text
description: Writes characters from a state table according to a bit mask, repeating the current character while the bit pattern does not change, and terminates the text with a zero byte.

name: call_helper_if_task_flagged
description: When a state flag is clear, looks up the current task through the library call and calls a helper when the task's field is nonzero.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B75A
name: wait_for_key_press
description: Prints a pause prompt asking for a key press, reads one key through the library input and read calls and runs the break check when the key is the break code. Helpers handle the output and signal work.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B7C2
name: write_lines_with_paging
description: Writes a counted block of text line by line through the library output and write calls, counting newlines. When a state flag is set it pauses for input after each full screen of lines.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B850
name: read_key_checking_break
description: Reads one key through the library input and read calls, runs the break check when the key is the break code, and returns the key.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B8A6
name: read_indexed_confirmation
description: Checks a per-item confirmation byte selected by the index in the data register, returning a cached result when one is set. Otherwise it reads a response letter and records affirmative or negative answers, mapping A, N, Q, S, Y and their lowercase forms to the matching result.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:B950
name: select_task_buffer_size
description: Returns a default size of 131072 unless a task lookup and the task's field give a computed value, which is returned instead. It skips the lookup while a state flag is set.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BA0C
name: sum_three_helper_results
description: Calls one helper for its side effect, then adds the results of three further helper calls and returns the total.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BABE
name: pack_dos_timestamp
description: Packs a file's date and time into DOS-style bit fields of a 32-bit word. Seconds are halved into a 5-bit field, minutes and hours fill their own fields, and the year, month and day are computed from the stored date using a month-length table and a leap-year adjustment.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BC14
name: pack_date_from_day_count
description: Subtracts month lengths from a day count to find the month and day, then writes the year, month and day into the bit fields of the destination word.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BC3A
name: pack_month_day_from_days
description: Subtracts month lengths from a day count until the remainder fits the current month, then writes the month and day fields of the destination word.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BC4C
name: find_month_and_pack_day
description: Walks the month lengths subtracting from the day count, then writes the month and day fields of the destination word once the remainder fits the current month.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BC76
name: find_month_and_pack_day
description: Walks the month lengths subtracting from the day count, then writes the month and day fields of the destination word once the remainder fits the current month.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BCD0
name: unpack_dos_timestamp
description: Reverses the packed DOS date and time: it extracts the minute, hour and year fields from the 32-bit word and computes a day count from the month-length table, adding a leap day where the year requires one, then stores the results.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BD5E
name: sum_month_lengths_to_day
description: Adds the lengths of the earlier months from a month-length table to the day count, adds a leap day for leap years and stores the resulting day number.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BD9C
name: append_path_component
description: Appends a second string to the first as a path part, inserting a slash between them unless the first ends in a colon or slash. When the first string is empty it copies the second string into it.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BDB2
name: append_path_component
description: Appends a second string to the first as a path part, inserting a slash between them unless the first ends in a colon or slash. When the first string is empty it copies the second string into it.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BDEE
name: scan_back_for_separator
description: Scans backward through a path string looking for a directory separator, stopping at the start of the string or at a volume colon. It returns without a result value.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BDFC
name: find_base_name_start
description: Scans backward from the end of the path for a separator or volume colon and returns a pointer to the character after it, which is the start of the base name.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BE0E
name: find_base_name_start
description: Scans backward from the end of the path using a counter held in a data register and returns the position following the last separator.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BE32
name: select_library_call_by_flags
description: Chooses between library calls using two state fields. When one flag is clear it calls through a table entry if one is set, otherwise a helper; when the flag is set it calls a different library routine.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BE4E
name: call_library_or_helper
description: Calls a helper when a state field is clear, otherwise calls the library routine at the table entry held in that field.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BE60
name: forward_to_handler
description: Trampoline that calls another routine and returns, with no other work of its own.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BE6E
name: copy_string_or_library
description: When a state flag is clear, copies a zero-terminated string byte by byte unless a state field selects a library routine for the copy. When the flag is set it calls a different library routine.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BE90
name: copy_string_or_library_routine
description: Copies a zero-terminated string byte by byte when a state field is clear, otherwise calls the library routine selected by that field.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BEA2
name: copy_zero_terminated_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from the source to the destination byte by byte, including the terminator.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BEB0
name: shutdown_and_exit
description: Runs a helper and then library shutdown calls, one of them only when a state field is set. It finishes by invoking the library exit routine with a saved return value.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BEB8
name: compute_fixed_point_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values held in the data registers as fixed-point numbers. It combines the cross products of the high and low 16-bit halves, shifted into the upper half, with the low-half product, and returns the 32-bit result.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BED8
name: divide_fixed_point_values
description: Divides one 32-bit fixed-point value by another, handling the signs separately and normalising the divisor by shifts before dividing. It returns the quotient in the fixed-point layout.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BF0A
name: divide_with_remainder_pair
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor and returns a 64-bit value that packs the quotient in the high part and the remainder in the low 32 bits. A divisor with a zero high word takes a direct path, while other divisors are normalised first.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BF9C
name: fill_four_handler_entries
description: Writes four routine addresses into consecutive words of the table it is given, filling a small dispatch table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BFA6
name: fill_handler_entries_with_stack
description: Writes two routine addresses and one value taken from the caller's stack into consecutive words of the destination table.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BFBC
name: stub_return_constant_one
description: Routine that only returns one, with no other work.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BFDC
name: lookup_error_code_entry
description: Searches a table of four-word entries for the key in the data register, reports the matching entry's message through a library call and returns its status code. When no entry matches it returns the fallback status, and two keys are treated specially for one state value.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:BFE8
name: print_error_for_code
description: Searches the error table for the code in the data register and prints the matching message through a library call. When no entry matches it prints the unknown error text, then returns the status code.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][a][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][a][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:C00E
name: print_table_entry_message
description: Prints the message stored in a table entry through a library call and returns the entry's status code, or the fallback code for the special key combination.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:0000
name: program_startup_setup
description: Program entry point: allocates a work block through the library, copies the initial data image into it, opens the system libraries by name, adjusts the task priority and runs its setup helpers before returning a result.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:01A4
name: program_shutdown_cleanup
description: Cleanup at exit: runs a helper and the library close and free routines, the close and free calls only when a state field is set. It restores the task priority through a library call and returns the stored value.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:0750
name: process_list_nodes_when_enabled
description: When a state flag is set, walks a circular list of nodes, calls a helper with each node's fields and runs a sequence of helper calls for entries that pass a check.

key: worms - custom levels (1995)(various)[h ramkids][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Custom Levels (1995)(Various)[h RamKids][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:07CE
name: build_path_prefix
description: Copies a stored text field into the destination, using a fallback field when the first is absent. It then either appends a slash or calls a helper to join the parts.
